condition.instanceCountMeaning: configured maximum; batch overlap intervals recorded separately

method.focus: All DOM focus events and actual native window transitions are candidates. Changes definitely before the command or after five seconds are retained separately. Numeric first-post-command bounds require a certainly-in-window candidate: the lower bound uses all remaining candidates, the upper bound only certainly-in-window candidates. Native poll intervals require bounded IPC clocks. Negative lower bounds express ordering uncertainty and are never clamped or interpreted as measured negative latency.
method.visibility: Last preserved false sample to first true sample; the nominal 25 ms interval is not substituted for missing polls.
method.predicate: Fresh sentinel after the five-second observation; it does not establish the predicate at the first focus transition. An owned native dialog with an unfocused renderer and no fresh sentinel has no workbench keybinding target; its underlying workbench context remains unobserved.
method.provider: Actual command-associated request candidates, client/server causal clock bounds and strict containment of the j keydown. Ambiguity remains explicit.
